protocol.inference: per-window conservative paired CP; no family-wide confidence or equivalence claim
protocol.objective: equal-weight mean exact hot V at alpha=.05 over seven finite L; one immutable layout per method
protocol.risk: all-record exact U on continuous alpha (0,.01] relative Raw24; exact V on the 32 preselected training records at all low-alpha breakpoints and all declared finite hot L relative Raw24; test does not tune
protocol.role: previously seen development windows; no confirmation claims
protocol.scope: bounded application payload, no network headers/kernel/device IO guarantee; authenticated metadata excluded from erasure population; hot cache provisioned explicitly; cold retrieves complete manifests/signatures
protocol.selection: Common 50 native FD/raw models. S1 fixed Raw24 coverage and geometry; S2 starts best feasible raw model and explores alternate coverage/geometry/grouping. Each gets 12 additional scores; shared baseline cost excluded and reported. UOnly24 retained. No equal-time claim.
protocol.test_targets: uniform outside 32 training targets; same rank filtered own N; independent new seeds

role: previously seen development windows; no confirmation claims
